intent: Top-of-page title with optional Breadcrumb trail, subtitle, actions, and page Tabs.
useWhen: Product page title with optional Breadcrumb trail and actions
Placing primary/secondary Buttons aligned to the page title
Page title with a search Input and one primary Button on the right
doNotUseWhen: Product top chrome with logo and search — use AppHeader
Path-only without a page title — use Breadcrumb

layout.note: Inside layout-header, PageHeader (its root is a header) is a flex item with basis 20rem that takes the free space, so siblings such as a Menu Button or a toolbar sit on the same row and wrap below it only when the row is narrower than 20rem plus their width. Alone it fills the row. Override the flex with className if you want something else.

title.note: 24/32 at heading weight: the largest of three title sizes (page 24, section 18, card 16).

subtitle.note: One line under the title, 14/20 secondary. Text, or inline nodes such as a lucide icon before a short scope line ("Applies to everyone in Northwind"): a leading svg is muted, 16px and centred on the text. Renders in a p, so no blocks, lists or buttons.

eyebrow.note: Kept for existing call sites. Sentence case, 12/16 at weight 500, never uppercase. Breadcrumbs replace eyebrow as the default where-am-I.

actions.note: Any node, laid out in a wrapping row, vertically centered: kit Buttons, a ButtonGroup, a search Input, a Select. At most one primary Button; it stays in view on narrow screens. A kit Input here sizes to its field (not full width), so it sits beside the Buttons; set a width with its className if you want one. Below 40rem the actions move under the title, except a single button (one Button or IconButton), which stays beside it.

overflowActions.note: Secondary actions. When the header is wider than 40rem they render as outline neutral Buttons before actions; narrower, they fold into one ⋯ kit DropdownMenu (KitLabels moreActions) after actions, so the labelled primary stays.

tabs.note: Kit Tabs, size md, line variant, for the page's views. Rendered under the title row inside the header, so a sticky header keeps them in view.

breadcrumbs.note: Same shape as Breadcrumb items. Rendered only when length >= 2. Passed through to kit Breadcrumb. When the header is narrower than 40rem, the trail shrinks to one back step to the crumb before the current page (if it has href or onClick).

breadcrumbSeparator.note: Passed through to kit Breadcrumb separator.

breadcrumbMaxItems.note: Passed through to kit Breadcrumb maxItems.

requirements: The narrow back step is a nav named Breadcrumb with a link that names the parent page
The ⋯ menu trigger is named More actions

doNot: Do not invent BreadcrumbItem or BreadcrumbLink cousins — compose kit Breadcrumb
Do not restyle Breadcrumb internals from PageHeader
Do not put more than one primary Button in actions (an Input or other controls beside it are fine)
Do not put page Tabs under PageHeader by hand — pass them to tabs
Do not put blocks, lists or buttons in subtitle — it is one line of inline content
snippet: <PageHeader title="Invoices" subtitle="Bills sent to customers this quarter." breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Billing", href: "#" }, { label: "Invoices" }]} overflowActions={[{ id: "export", label: "Export", icon: "Download", onSelect: () => {} }]} actions={<Button iconStart="Plus">New invoice</Button>} tabs={<Tabs items={[{ id: "all", label: "All" }, { id: "overdue", label: "Overdue", count: 3 }]} />} />
